title: DiffusionRVGE: Reinforcement Learning via Regression-Based Value Gradient Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning improves diffusion models using rewards on generated images, but repeated denoising and gradient estimation make training expensive. We introduce \method, an efficient method that constructs useful update directions by regressing centered rewards on centered final denoised images. It requires neither reward derivatives nor adjoint backpropagation through the sampling trajectory. A unified first-variation formulation identifies the value-gradient target with or without a trajectory-KL penalty. A population analysis under Gaussian noising explains the regression geometry, while a subspace analysis motivates clean-image coordinates. The implementation adapts rollout bandwidth and query weights to reward continuity: local rollouts suit smooth rewards, whereas broader groups provide informative contrasts for discrete rewards. Trained jointly on five rewards, one SD3.5-Medium model matches or exceeds DiffusionNFT's joint

translated_title: DiffusionRVGE：通过基于回归的价值梯度估计进行强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习通过在生成图像上施加奖励来改进扩散模型，但反复去噪和梯度估计使训练成本高昂。我们提出了 DiffusionRVGE，一种高效的方法，它通过在中心化后的最终去噪图像上回归中心化后的奖励来构建有用的更新方向。它既不需要奖励函数的导数，也不需要沿采样轨迹进行伴随反向传播。一个统一的初等变分（first-variation）公式在有或没有轨迹 KL 惩罚的情况下都能确定价值梯度目标。基于高斯噪声的总体分析解释了回归的几何结构，而子空间分析则论证了使用干净图像坐标的合理性。该实现根据奖励的连续性自适应地调整回滚带宽和查询权重：局部回滚适合平滑的奖励，而更宽泛的分组则为离散奖励提供有信息量的对比。在五个奖励上联合训练后，一个 SD3.5-Medium 模型匹配或超越了 DiffusionNFT 的联合训练表现。
tldr: 该论文提出 DiffusionRVGE，一种通过在最终去噪图像上回归中心化奖励来估计价值梯度的高效强化学习方法，无需奖励导数或伴随反向传播，并能根据奖励的平滑或离散特性自适应调整回滚策略，使单个 SD3.5-Medium 模型在五个奖励上联合训练即可匹敌或超越 DiffusionNFT。
en_tdlr: DiffusionRVGE is an efficient reinforcement learning method for diffusion models that estimates value gradients by regressing centered rewards on final denoised images—requiring neither reward derivatives nor adjoint backpropagation—and adaptively adjusts rollout bandwidth to reward continuity, enabling a single SD3.5-Medium model to match or exceed DiffusionNFT when jointly trained on five rewards.
